after.name: c. 3000–2600 BC: Dholavira early site context; chronology debated

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: The 29th century architecture page points to Dholavira, and UNESCO dates earliest site evidence around 3000 BCE. The Dholavira page also reports a newer radiocarbon-based proposal for phase II c.3200–2600 and an older scheme starting c.2650, so absolute dating and period names are contested. The -3000..-2599 game window is a conservative context reference within one proposal, not a date of construction or proof of occupation on every year. No later fortifications, reservoirs, script, trade networks or rulers are asserted for 2870. The site pin and 20 km radius are gameplay references, not boundaries. NewsIndex may display this long context repeatedly. Existing nearby -2650 detail event and Pleiades site span/rank remain independently unverified.
r2SourceEvidence.date_precision: One approximate reference window, phase boundaries and exact-year occupation disputed.

before.name: BC: The 365-day calendar year was installed in ancient Egypt, with fixed lunar months of 30 days + 5 epagomenal days

after.name: c. 2874 BC: One proposed Egyptian civil-calendar origin; date uncertain

r2SourceEvidence.review_note: The century overview offers c.2874 for a 365-day calendar, but the inherited event was stored at -2900 and mislabeled the fixed civil months as lunar. The detailed article describes a 365-day civil solar calendar (12 x 30 plus five extra days), alongside a separate lunar calendar; it treats early origins as speculative and discusses other dates. EBSCO suggests c.2773 while acknowledging the creation date is debatable. The new -2874 slot records only the overview’s proposed estimate, not a verified inauguration or evidence that the later documented structure existed exactly then. The cited archived bibliography entry in the overview has not been independently checked. Coordinate/radius are regional gameplay settings.
r2SourceEvidence.date_precision: One proposed approximate origin date; actual adoption date uncertain.
r2SourceEvidence.location_precision: Regional reference for Egypt, not an attested event location.
